# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 6 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Peace of the One Who Trusts

---

**6:1** Blessed is the man whose heart is ready to call on the name of the LORD —
he will be saved the moment he remembers the LORD's name.

**6:2** His ways are established by the LORD;
the works of his hands are under God's watchful care.

**6:3** His soul will not tremble before any evil dream;
when he passes through flooded rivers and surging waters he will not be disturbed.

**6:4** He wakes from sleep blessing the name of the LORD;
with a heart at peace he sings to his God.

**6:5** He pleads with the LORD for all the people of his house;
the LORD hears the prayer of everyone who truly fears him.

**6:6** May the LORD fulfill every prayer of those who fear him —
blessed are the LORD's devout ones, who receive his salvation!

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic rendering prioritizing poetic force and contemporary resonance.*
